config.state: Photograph of a construction site. Judge only what can be seen in the image. An object being present is not a violation by itself. Normal construction activity with proper safety measures is not a violation.

questions.Fall_Hazard: Is a worker exposed to a fall from height because of an unprotected edge or opening, or an unsafe ladder, scaffold, or work platform?
questions.StruckBy_Hazard: Is anyone at risk of being struck by falling objects or by suspended, overhead, or unstable loads or materials?
questions.Electrocution_Hazard: Is there an electrical hazard, such as exposed wiring, damaged cables, unsafe temporary power, or work close to energized equipment or power lines?
questions.CaughtInBetween_hazard: Is machinery or equipment being used unsafely, or is a worker exposed to unguarded machinery, pinch points, crushing, or being caught between objects?
questions.PPE_Violation: Is a visible worker missing required personal protective equipment, such as a hard hat, high-visibility vest, gloves, eye protection, or fall-arrest harness, or wearing it incorrectly?
questions.Housekeeping_Storage: Is there poor housekeeping, such as debris, clutter, blocked walkways, trip or slip hazards, or unsafely stored materials?
questions.Other: Is there another visible safety hazard outside falls, struck-by, electrical, machinery, PPE, and housekeeping, such as missing warning signs, missing barricades, or poor site communication?
